description: Add search filters allowing users to narrow results by category and city
kb_answer:
You can filter members by their primary (top‑level) category and then limit the results to a specific city. The dynamic search‑results pages support this combination with a URL pattern such as:

```
/%country_name%/%city_name%/%profession%
```

Here “%profession%” is the top‑level category and “%city_name%” is the city you want to restrict the search to. Use the **Top‑Level Category** filter to select the category, then apply the city segment in the URL (or the corresponding city filter) to see only members in that city.

description: Implement a monthly newsletter that is sent only to members who have opted in
kb_answer: The newsletter form includes a consent checkbox that lets visitors actively opt‑in. When they check it, their consent is recorded in the **user_consent** column for that member, enabling you to identify the monthly newsletter opt‑in list. If the installer is skipped, the checkbox won’t appear and no consent will be stored.
